newsitem.title: USA: Analyst surprised by AT&T uncollectibles.
newsitem.headline: Analyst surprised by AT&T uncollectibles.

text.p: AT&T Corp's fourth quarter results at first glance looked to have undershot analysts consensus because of a suprise $200 million increase in uncollectible revenues in the quarter.

"No one was expecting that," said Bette Massick, an analyst at Bear Stearns. "However, base business looked good. Volumes in long distance was better, revenue growth better than we expected," she said.
AT&T operating net was $0.76 per share compared with First Call's $0.79 consensus, and $0.68 reported a year ago.
AT&T said the rise in uncollectibles were affected by higher fraud, delinquencies and bankruptcies among its business customers.
Analysts were awaiting the conference call before giving further views. (( Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859-1712))
